text: Handling deadlines successfully requires a few key skills. First, good time management is essential. Plan your schedule and set aside enough time for each task. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you do not waste energy on small things. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish. If a task is too big, break it into smaller parts or agree on a smaller result. Finally, communication is very important. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early. Do not wait until the last minute. By combining these four skills, you can reduce stress and meet your deadlines more reliably.
